carbon_policy_signal.item: EU carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) revenue confirmed in budget negotiations; exemption scope and long-term EUA offset funding clarified.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: CBAM revenue clarity supports EUA price floor by reducing free-allocation erosion risk; shapes power sector decarbonization capex path and fossil fuel switching incentives.

freshness_caveat: Coal data stale (256 days old, as of 2025-12-26); 7th-percentile headline unreliable for merit-order thermal dispatch assessment. TTF, GB Power, Storage, EUA all current (≤4 days).
risk_flags: GB Power 158.8 EUR/MWh (94th-pctile) and EU Storage 16.4pp below seasonal — refill pace through Q4 will determine winter power curve shape.
Slovakia blocks Russia sanctions 12-month lock-in — unresolved extension prolongs TTF volatility and upside risk if EU supply flows remain threatened.
US LNG exports +23% YoY and Norway ramp both bearish-power via TTF compression; monitor arbitrage window closure if US-EU spreads tighten further.

base.summary: Storage refill through Q4 gradual; Norway/US LNG supply moderates TTF scarcity premium; GB power normalizes toward 60th-pctile.

downside.summary: Norway ramp accelerates; US LNG arbitrage widens; mild Q4 weather; storage fills ahead of seasonal; Russia sanctions extended and supply normalizes.

upside.summary: EU sanctions negotiation fails; Russia gas flows threatened or cut; storage refill stalls; Norway ramp delayed. TTF repricing on supply shock; GB/DE power rallies on thermal backup.

Norway gas ramp and US LNG surge compress TTF premium
